messages:
carmen: Opening a short PR to tidy the starter quickstart for container deploys + CI tips. Goals: tighten auth steps, add a tiny Python snippet (people asked), include a Dockerfile example, and fix the broken 'deploy:containers' anchor that moved. Will tag reviewers shortly.

oleg: thanks — can you also add a GitHub Actions snippet showing how to inject REDWOOD_API_KEY as a secret? new users often paste the key into workflows by accident.

carmen: yes. plan is to add this GH action step (masked example):

```
- name: Set REDWOOD_API_KEY
  env:
    REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}
  run: echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY is set"
```

and call out that `secrets` is required and not to echo the key in logs.

tess: please include a one-line Python example using the new package import (people asked for it in the docs survey). keep it minimal, like the JS/curl examples.

carmen: Python snippet will be two lines: `from redwood import Redwood\nclient = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']); print(client.generate('Hello').text)` — i'll format properly in the PR.

sam: small nit: add Dockerfile CMD example so first-time deployers can run locally: `CMD ["/bin/sh", "-c", "uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT"]`. also mention the `PORT` env var on our platform.

oleg: add a short troubleshooting blurb for CI: common failed deploy is missing `--public` flag or the wrong region env; mention to check `REDWOOD_REGION` in workflows.

carmen: good call. i will replace the old anchor links with file anchors and add the CI sample + Dockerfile + python snippet. also adding a brief note about token scopes for starter tokens and a pointer to pinning models for Dedicated (`model: redwood/fast-qa@v1.2.0`).

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389  title: "Starter quickstart: container & CI auth clarifications + py snippet + anchor fix" (author: carmen)

tess: i'll do a pass on the Python wording and the Dockerfile formatting. if we can merge before the site deploy tonight that'd be ideal.

oleg: reviewing now, will drop inline comments for the GH Actions snippet and the anchor replacement.

carmen: thanks all  ping here if anything blocks, and feel free to add small follow-ups in the PR rather than here. :shipit:
